title: The derived completion of local cohomology as a derived limit
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the derived I-adic completion of local cohomology with support in a closed subscheme with the derived limit of the local cohomology of the quotients by the powers of the ideal, and gives the short exact sequences computing its cohomology from the first derived limit and the limit (author lemma at source lines 2326-2341, label lemma-completion-local). The proof (source lines 2343-2367) writes the local cohomology as an extended Cech complex, uses the description of derived completion to replace it by the complex of ordinary completions, observes that the transition maps are surjective so that the derived limit is an ordinary limit, and breaks the derived limit into the displayed short exact sequences (proof lines 2359-2366). The comparison of the two complexes is the substance. H3.
